high_level_description: The image shows three individuals standing together outdoors in front of a building with wooden doors and windows. The person on the left is wearing a dark blue t-shirt and has headphones around their neck. They have long hair tied back. The individual in the middle appears to be an older woman dressed in a traditional outfit consisting of a red and orange patterned saree with a matching blouse. She has white hair and is smiling warmly. The person on the right is wearing a black sports jersey with yellow stripes on the shoulders and a red collar.
